description: The Yogi government will invest over ₹10,700 crore to develop India's first 'AI City' in Lucknow
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh govt bets big on AI, data centres to boost jobs and IT parks The Yogi government will invest over ₹10,700 crore to develop India's first 'AI City' in Lucknow premium Listen to This Article Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath recently said the state government is building a network of information technology (IT) parks, in a bid to boost employment opportunities.
